bio.en: The PKU Physical Intelligence Lab at Peking University, led by Prof. Zhibo Pang, focuses on robots and autonomous control systems for both traditional and emerging industrial scenarios. We develop the full stack of urgently needed intelligent software and hardware technologies — from multimodal embodied AI models to high-dynamic dexterous robotic systems — with the goal of redefining flexible precision manufacturing through embodied intelligence.
bio.zh: 北京大学北京大学物理智能实验室由庞智博教授领衔，聚焦面向传统与新兴工业场景的机器人与自动控制系统，研发产业界亟需的智能与软硬件全栈技术——从多模态具身智能模型到高动态灵巧机器人系统，以具身智能重新定义柔性精密制造。

bio.en: Our research is organized around the PAM (Physical-Attribute Model) paradigm: a unified embodied-intelligence framework that represents the physical semantics affecting robot action generation, efficiently produces massive simulation scenarios and training data, and delivers generalization, precision, and industrial-grade reliability for high-value contact-rich manipulation tasks. We pursue a deep integration of mechanics, classical control, and artificial intelligence.
bio.zh: 我们的研究围绕 PAM（物理属性模型）范式展开：一套统一的具身智能框架，用于表征影响机器人动作生成的物理语义，高效生成海量仿真场景与训练数据，并为高价值富接触操作任务提供泛化性、精度与工业级可靠性。我们追求力学、经典控制与人工智能的深度融合。

bio.en: Prof. Pang proposed the Cloud-Fog Automation (CFA) and Cloud-Fog Robotics technology frameworks in 2017, which were later highlighted by ABB's global CTO and adopted in ABB's product strategy, including the OmniCore robot controller generation. Before joining Peking University, he spent twelve years at ABB Corporate Research Sweden, where he led the software and communication technologies of several world-first industrial products, including ABB Mobile YuMi — the industry's first mobile dual-arm humanoid collaborative robot.
bio.zh: 庞智博教授于 2017 年提出云雾自动化（CFA）与云雾机器人技术体系，后被 ABB 全球 CTO 在主旨演讲中重点阐述，并纳入 ABB 产品战略，包括新一代机器人控制器 OmniCore。加入北京大学前，他在 ABB 瑞典研究院工作十二年，领导了多项业界首创工业产品的软件与通信技术，包括 ABB Mobile YuMi——业界首款移动式双臂类人协作机器人。

opportunities.en: We are recruiting Ph.D. students, master students, postdoctoral researchers, visiting scholars, and research interns!
opportunities.zh: 我们长期招收博士生、硕士生、博士后、访问学者与科研实习生！

opportunities.en: If you are passionate about embodied AI, robotics, physics-informed machine learning, or industrial cyber-physical systems, and want to work on problems that matter for real industry, you are very welcome to join us. Postdoctoral positions on foundation models are currently open.
opportunities.zh: 如果你对具身智能、机器人、物理信息机器学习或工业信息物理系统充满热情，并希望攻克真正面向产业的问题，欢迎加入我们。目前基础模型方向的博士后岗位虚位以待。

opportunities.en: Please send your CV, transcripts, and a short description of your research interests to zhibo.pang@pku.edu.cn.
opportunities.zh: 请将个人简历、成绩单与简短的研究兴趣说明发送至 zhibo.pang@pku.edu.cn。

slides.alt: Embodied AI for cable manipulation scenarios
slides.title_zh: 具身智能模型与机器人学习
slides.desc_en: Multimodal embodied foundation models (VLA / world models / PAM), imitation and reinforcement learning for contact-rich manipulation, sim-to-real transfer, and reliable long-horizon task planning through physics-semantics-driven agent clusters (PySAC).
slides.desc_zh: 多模态具身基础模型（VLA / 世界模型 / PAM）、面向富接触操作的模仿与强化学习、仿真到真实的迁移，以及通过物理语义驱动的智能体集群（PySAC）实现可靠的长程任务规划。

slides.desc_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), neural operators for large-scale multi-scale PDE solving, and mechanism–data fusion models that bring physical semantics into learning-based control.
slides.desc_zh: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）、面向大规模多尺度 PDE 求解的神经算子，以及将物理语义引入学习型控制的机理–数据融合模型。

slides.title_zh: 云雾自动化与工业信息物理系统
slides.desc_en: Cloud-Fog Automation (CFA): software-defined, intelligence-native industrial control infrastructure with communication–computing–control co-design, virtualized controllers, converged 5G/6G networks, and functional safety.
slides.desc_zh: 云雾自动化（CFA）：智能原生的软件定义工业控制基础设施，通信–计算–控制协同设计、虚拟化控制器、融合的 5G/6G 网络与功能安全。

slides.title_zh: 机器人系统与工业部署
slides.desc_en: High-dynamic dexterous robotic systems, dexterous hands, embodied toolchains (ETC), embodied model libraries (EML), and edge controllers (ECC) — deployed as reusable process packages for flexible precision manufacturing in semiconductor, aerospace, rail-transit, and new-energy equipment.
slides.desc_zh: 高动态灵巧机器人系统、灵巧手、具身工具链（ETC）、具身模型库（EML）与边缘控制器（ECC）——作为可复用的工艺包部署于半导体、航空航天、轨道交通与新能源装备的柔性精密制造。

groups.title_zh: 具身智能与机器人学习

papers.cite: D. Hu et al., "TRACE: Trajectory Action Chunking Enhancement for Robust Imitation Learning in Robotic Manipulation," in IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2026.
papers.note_en: Improves precision from ±1.2 to ±0.15 via encoder debiasing and visual–trajectory cross-attention.
papers.note_zh: 通过编码器去偏与视觉–轨迹交叉注意力，将精度从 ±1.2 提升至 ±0.15。

papers.cite: D. Hu et al., "Spectral-Temporal Conditioning: A Frequency-Domain Framework for Robust Robotic Imitation Learning" (Temp-ACT), in IEEE Transactions on Consumer Electronics, 2026.
papers.note_en: Frequency-domain policy learning lifts long-horizon success rate from 3% to 36%.
papers.note_zh: 频域策略学习将长程任务成功率从 3% 提升至 36%。

papers.cite: Y. Chen et al., "TCSC: Time-Consistent Synchronization and Completion for Bridging the Temporal Sim-to-Real Gap in Embodied Intelligence," in IEEE Transactions on Consumer Electronics, 2026.
papers.note_en: Wasserstein-aware causal synchronization raises task success from ~68% to 75%.
papers.note_zh: 基于 Wasserstein 的因果同步将任务成功率从约 68% 提升至 75%。

papers.cite: F. Ma et al., "Embodied Artificial Intelligence-Driven Integrated Development Environment for Industrial Automation Systems: Requirements and Framework," in IEEE Industrial Electronics Magazine, 2026.
Y. Liu et al., "VistaCo: Synergizing Visual Attention and Task Cognition in Robot Visuomotor Policy Learning," Forty-First AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI), 2027, under review.
papers.note_en: Real-world success rate improved from 44.5% to 67.5%.
papers.note_zh: 真实场景成功率由 44.5% 提升至 67.5%。

papers.cite: Y. Lou et al., "DynamicWAM: Dual-Path Motion Conditioning for World–Action Models in Dynamic Manipulation," Forty-First AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI), 2027, under review.
papers.note_en: Dual-path motion conditioning lifts the DOMINO benchmark success rate from 29.3% (previous SOTA) to 38.2%.
papers.note_zh: 双路径运动条件将 DOMINO 基准成功率从此前 SOTA 的 29.3% 提升至 38.2%。

papers.cite: D. Song et al., "RegGraft: Region-Aware Block Reuse in Diffusion Transformers," Forty-First AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI), 2027, under review.
papers.note_en: 25% improvement in diffusion training efficiency via cross-domain block grafting.
papers.note_zh: 通过跨域模块嫁接，扩散训练效率提升 25%。

papers.cite: F. Ma et al., "PhyGen: Physics-Informed Repair Fields for Generated Robot Demonstrations," Forty-First AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI), 2027, under review.
papers.note_en: Rigid-body demonstration generation yield raised from 55.6% to 93.5%.
papers.note_zh: 刚体示范生成良率由 55.6% 提升至 93.5%。

papers.cite: Y. Fu et al., "CableSort: Force-Guided Dual-Arm Sorting of Stacked Cables," RSS 2026 DAROMA Workshop, 2026.
papers.note_en: Instance-mask IoU improved from 0.36 to 0.93 over the strongest segmentation baseline, with 48% end-to-end sorting success.
papers.note_zh: 相较最强分割基线，实例掩码 IoU 由 0.36 提升至 0.93，端到端分拣成功率达 48%。

papers.cite: "ViPS: Visuomotor Policy-to-Servo Coordination for Precision Industrial Manipulation," IEEE Transactions on Industrial Cyber-Physical Systems (TICPS), under review.
papers.note_en: Installation success rate improved from 35% to 78%.
papers.note_zh: 装配成功率由 35% 提升至 78%。

papers.cite: "UPST: Unified Pose-Stream Teleoperation for Heterogeneous Robot Control and Demonstration Generation," submitted to IEEE Industrial Electronics Magazine, 2026.
papers.note_en: Unified pose-stream teleoperation cuts task time by 24.5% over the VR baseline and raises ACT success from 69.5% to 76.8%.
papers.note_zh: 统一位姿流遥操作相较 VR 基线缩短任务时间 24.5%，并将 ACT 成功率由 69.5% 提升至 76.8%。

papers.cite: "CRAFT: A Cloud-Fog Automation Synergistic Framework Empowered by Embodied AI in Precision Manufacturing," Robotics and Computer-Integrated Manufacturing (RCIM), under review.
papers.note_en: Cloud–fog–edge task execution lifts real-factory success from 39.5% to 76.5% with ~7× longer continuous autonomous operation.
papers.note_zh: 云–雾–边协同执行将真实工厂成功率由 39.5% 提升至 76.5%，连续自主运行时间延长约 7 倍。
